facts: Closing costs typically run 2 to 4 percent of the purchase price, plus earnest money and moving costs.
A lender must send the Closing Disclosure at least 3 business days before closing. Compare it with the Loan Estimate and ask questions.
Pre-approval is different from pre-qualification: pre-approval means a lender has reviewed your documents.
Avoid opening new credit, financing furniture, or changing jobs from the time you apply for a loan through closing.
Private mortgage insurance is typically required on conventional loans when the down payment is under 20 percent.
FHA loans allow a down payment as low as 3.5 percent. VA loans typically require no down payment and no monthly mortgage insurance, though a funding fee may apply.
Months of supply is how long it would take to sell every active listing at the current pace of sales. Under 4 months favors sellers, 4 to 6 months is balanced, and over 6 months favors buyers.
Wire fraud is real: verify wire instructions by phone using a number you already trust, and never rely on emailed wire instructions.
Tennessee sellers complete the residential property condition disclosure (or exemption), and the lead-based paint disclosure applies to homes built before 1978.
Termite and wood-destroying organism (WDO) inspections are commonly requested by buyers and lenders in Tennessee.
School assignment and property taxes depend on the exact address, so verify them with the school district and the county for any home you are serious about.
Request quotes from at least 3 licensed moving companies and book early for month-end dates.
Radon testing, a sewer scope and a termite inspection are common add-ons to a standard home inspection.
Cancel homeowner's insurance on a sold home only after closing is confirmed.
Spring Hill includes parts of both Williamson and Maury counties, so county services, schools and taxes can differ by address.
Murfreesboro is in Rutherford County and Columbia is in Maury County; neither is in Williamson County.
